tier.description:
What tier to load initially. By default, the initial connection only loads the lightest tier (REST).

@see Remote.TypeLoaderSpec#tier

async.description:
If the #tier is `THIN` or `FULL`, whether to load an async version of the type system.

@see Remote.TypeLoaderSpec#async

redirectLoginHandler.description:
Handle login redirect response and return an authorization token if successful.

@param res native HTTP response instance

requestTimeoutHandler.description:
Handle ETIMEDOUT error when sending a {@link HttpRequest}

@param err caught error object

numRetries.description: Maximum number of times to retry a connect request by calling the #redirectLoginHandler.

forceLocalTypes.description:
Types marked to have all methods local using forceLocal (if full type system).
Used in @see Remote.TypeLoaderSpec#forceLocalTypes

noSourceMapPointer.description:
If true, do not append sourceMappingURL in source files of all types.
Used in from @see Remote.TypeLoaderSpec#noSourceMapPointer

pkgRoots.description:
Mapping of package name to package local root on client side.
Used to locate implementation file paths in source map files for Node users.
Used in @see Remote.TypeLoaderSpec#pkgRoots

interactive.description:
If true, the connection is intended to be used in an interactive session and extra setup is performed to better
support browser developer tools, the Node.js CLI, or the Jupyter notebook.

title: Options that may be specified to {@link Remote.connect} and {@link Remote.connectAsync connectAsync}.
name: RemoteConnectSpec
